generate_pointnav_episodes: generate PointNav navigation episodes for a HabitatSim simulator with configurable distance limits and complexity ratio
check_compatible_episode: check if a source and target position form a compatible navigation episode within distance bounds
create_navigation_episode: create a NavigationEpisode object with start position, rotation, target, and optional shortest paths
compute_ratio_sample_rate: compute the aggressive rejection sampling rate for episodes with low geodesic to Euclidean distance ratio
review_generate_pointnav_episode: review the generate_pointnav_episode generator function for navigation complexity filtering and rejection sampling logic
